# workflowkit

```go
import "github.com/kitsunium/sdk/framework/internal/kit/workflowkit"
```

Package workflowkit is what framework/kit/workflow plugs into kit: the engine kit's workflows run on — the SDK's statemachine, instantiated once, over kit's entity and the state's spelling (ADR 0179 §1, step 5, Q3) —, its loop of timers and guards, and the conversions between the engine's values and plug's. kit's core imports none of the SDK's statemachine: it reaches it through plug, and a product that declares no workflow links none of it.

Package workflowkit — the compile-time proof that the engine is kit's.
